turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I think school uniforms should be mandatory because they cut down on bullying.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: But uniforms limit how students express themselves.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Surely the cost of buying uniforms hurts poor families.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Uniforms make students look the same, so nobody feels left out.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do uniforms actually improve grades though?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Parents already pay for plenty of school supplies.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Mandatory uniforms are a good idea for school safety.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Students can still be bullied for their shoes or backpacks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Isn't the research on uniforms pretty weak?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Uniforms prepare students for the workplace dress codes they will face later.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Self expression matters more than a tidy look.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Why should schools control what children wear at all?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Uniforms would end the daily fight over what to wear.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Children develop identity through clothing choices.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Many schools without uniforms do just fine.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A uniform policy is easy for teachers to enforce.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Enforcement takes time away from teaching.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Students who break the rule get punished unfairly.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Uniforms improve discipline across the whole school.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Discipline comes from teachers, not from clothes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Show me a study that proves uniforms change behavior.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wealthy students show off with expensive clothes, and uniforms stop that.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: They will just show off with shoes and phones instead.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So the problem moves somewhere else.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Private schools use uniforms and get better results.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Those schools also have more funding and smaller classes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Correlation is not the same as causation here.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Uniforms make mornings simpler for busy families.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Buying several sets of uniforms is not cheap.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hand me downs work better for clothes than for uniforms.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Uniforms help students feel they belong to their school.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Belonging should come from the community, not a dress code.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Some students feel uncomfortable in a uniform.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Strict uniform rules keep students focused on learning.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Focus depends on sleep and teaching quality.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Would you ban uniforms if the evidence turned against them?
